Coram : S.N. VARIAVA*, AR. LAKSHMANAN, S.H. KAPADIA
B Sales Tax: Delhi Sales Tax Act, 1975, Section 4(2)(a)(v)-Delhi Sales Tax Rules, 1975-Rule 8(4)(c)-Sale transaction-Purchasing dealer failing to submit C ST-/ form-liability of selling dealer to pay sales tax-Held, selling dealer is liable to pay sales tax-Object of the Act being to check evasion lose its tax entitlement. The question which arose in present appeals is whether selling dealer who is not issued ST-1 forms by their purchasing dealer is disentitled to D claim benefit of Section 4(2)(a)(v) of Delhi Sales Tax Act, 1975 and liable to pay tax on such transaction.
Decision Date : 25-01-2005 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 1717/1999 | Direction Issue : C.A. 1717/1719/99 ALLOWED, CA 308,313,314,315/2003 AND SLP 1954/2003 DISMISSED | Bench : 3 Judges
